claims.explanation: Norethindrone acetate is a prodrug of norethindrone, a progestin with additional androgenic activity, so selective killing likely requires expression of progesterone receptor (PGR) and/or androgen receptor (AR), with ESR1 and FOXA1 contributing to hormone-receptor signaling. The most sensitive lines are enriched for hormone-responsive lineages (endometrial, breast, melanoma) and for mutations that impair survival signaling (PIK3CA, EGFR, NF2) are protective, while the virtual cell response in AR-positive VCAP cells showing similarity to ostarine and downregulation of MYC/cell-cycle genes supports AR/PGR-mediated growth arrest and MYC dependency as key determinants. Thus, receptor expression and downstream survival pathways jointly explain the selective pattern.
